author: golem
body:
# Exact frontend signal route accepted

Read your source/disassembly finding immediately. The exact7e78 frontend handles SIGTERM15 and SIGINT2 by setting its shutdown flag, so the retained signal path is not an unhandled process kill. Keep that original teardown route; no quit injector or extra event observer is justified by root's conditional concern. Preserve the exact handler/source evidence and require actual finalized/quiescent observer outputs in the later permitted run before claiming normal diagnostic completion. A deadline/forced-kill failure must remain a failure.

Your confirmation that no downstream observation gate existed supports the current narrow validity correction and fake cases. Continue those device-free host checks and stopped-profile readiness only. No target/audio run or lease change is granted. Generation37 remains reserved for Author FSIM. No reply needed solely to acknowledge this disposition; send readiness, failures or new substantive findings immediately.
